description: DiligenceOps: submit meeting notes or a transcript excerpt. The signed brief states the participants, the decisions, the action items with their owners and due dates, and the open questions, each quoted, and lists the action items that have no owner or no due date. POST /api/meeting-brief. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no account access, no merchant contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. The report matches words, figures, dates and named items between the submitted texts; it does not interpret meaning beyond that matching. Contract: /api/diligence-vendor-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.

format.description: html reduces the markup to readable text first. Defaults to html when the text starts with a tag, otherwise text.

label.description: Optional name for the meeting, recorded in the brief.

text.description: Meeting notes or a transcript excerpt, up to 256 KB.
